Container.Name: Dockit
Container.Overview: Pin your URLs. A shared home page for the tools your team actually opens — Grafana, Proxmox, GitLab, the firewall, the wiki — organised by space, category and card.[br][br]Self-hosted on Unraid. One JSON file in appdata, no database. Backup = copy the folder. Local login always works; LDAP / AD and OIDC (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia) are optional.
Container.Description:
IT teams live in dozens of consoles, monitors and wikis. The links scatter across bookmarks, chat and mail. Dockit pins them on one page the whole team shares, organised by space, category and card (app, note, or embed).
The portal is one JSON file on the appdata share. No database. Backup or move = copy that folder.
First start: set Edit password (12+ characters). Sign in as admin with that password. HTTP link checks need no extra privileges. ICMP (ping) needs Extra Parameters: --user 0 --cap-add=NET_RAW (keep --user 0). You can leave ping off.
SSO client secret and LDAP bind password: paste them in Dockit Settings, or set the optional variables below. Local login always remains.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: portal urls bookmarks intranet dashboard homelab grafana proxmox
Container.Requires: A strong PORTAL_EDIT_PASSWORD (12 characters or more).
Container.Changes: Appdata permissions: PUID/PGID (default 99:100) and --user 0 so the entrypoint can chown then drop. Clearer store overview.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: portal.json, curation and uploaded assets. Writable by PUID:PGID (default 99:100). Backup this folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns appdata. Unraid nobody is 99. Leave at 99 unless you know you need another uid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns appdata. Unraid users is 100.

Config.Name: Edit password
Config.Description: Required. 12 characters or more. First login is this password for user admin (or Edit user below).

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Public URL if behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://portal.example. Leave empty on the LAN.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 when behind a reverse proxy so Dockit honours X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the SSO secret is not stored in portal.json. Otherwise paste it in Dockit Settings.

Config.Name: LDAP bind password
Config.Description: Optional. One bind password for every directory. Different accounts: leave this empty and use PORTAL_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD_<ID>, or paste in Settings.
